summary: Both Berquist Sherman method pages now let you select cells in any calculation grid and copy their values, the way the Dataset Viewer and Result Selection grids do.
details: Click a cell, drag a rectangle, Shift-click to extend, Ctrl-click to add a range, or click a row label or column header to select the whole line, on every sub-tab of the Method tab.
Ctrl+C or right-click and Copy values puts the selected figures on the clipboard as a tab-delimited block ready to paste into Excel; Escape or Remove Highlights clears the selection.
Select Leading Diagonal on the Proportion Settled view now sits in the same right-click menu.
